scope: 2019 and newer · under 20k miles · clean title · nationwide
title: What Each Car Has Been Through
lead: 25 720S listings under 20k miles on CARFAX; 7 coupes fit. Ranked by how the car has lived, not by price.
facts: Gray 2019 has a tune and downpipes
takeaway: My two cents: Motor Cars of Chicago's red 2019 at $229,995 is the only clean coupe inside your $240k cap. Get its photos and a PPI first: it went through an auction last month. The gray 2019 is off the list: the dealer's own page says tune and downpipes. Everything over $260k is Spider money, so the 2022 at $299,800 is out.
shift: classic.com, Mar 13, 2026. Looks low; may be a bid, not a sale
Coupe asks under 20k mi start at $230k; 720S Spider sales run about $25k above coupes
Ferrari of Central Florida 2019: CARFAX shows 20,556 mi, over the limit. Motor Cars of Chicago 2019 Gray #9935: 7 owners. McLaren North Jersey 2019: Canadian commercial use and a turbo replaced
sources: Listings and full CARFAX reports from carfax.com dealer listings (free reports), read Nov 7, 2026 in the built-in browser; Autotrader for European Exotic Center. Sold results from classic.com and Cars & Bids via Codex, Nov 7. Days listed from CARFAX first-seen dates. Window stickers and option lists: every dealer site checked VIN by VIN Nov 7 (iPacket, documents, description); a card says "Dealer site: no sticker" only after that check.

cars.verdict: Pick: the only clean coupe under the cap. $229,995 on the dealer's site plus a $377.63 doc fee, inside $230k to $240k. Cheapest clean coupe. Six straight years of dealer service and one windshield, but it came through an auction last month and has the most miles. Good number to anchor a lowball on the others.

cars.verdict: $9,995 over the cap, and the dealer lists it with a tune and downpipes. A modified engine on a 720S is a warranty and resale problem: only with stock parts back on and at $240k. Lowest miles, McLaren-serviced its whole life. The door hardware repairs are common 720S fixes, not red flags. Same Joliet dealer as the R8, Yelp 2.0.
